whatIs.title: What Is Metadata?
whatIs.description: Metadata is hidden information stored inside files, images, and documents that can reveal sensitive details such as device information, location data, timestamps, software versions, and author details.

matters.title: Why It Matters
matters.desc: Every time you take a photo or save a document, your device quietly embeds personal footprints into the file. This hidden data travels with the file wherever it goes.

risks.title: Why Metadata Can Be Dangerous
risks.subtitle: The silent threat of data exposure through file sharing.

items.title: GPS Location Leaks
items.desc: Photos taken on smartphones embed exact GPS coordinates of your home or workplace.

items.title: Device Fingerprinting
items.desc: Camera models, serial numbers, and OS versions can be used to track you across uploads.

items.title: Author Identification
items.desc: PDFs and Word documents store the creator's name and organization by default.

formats.title: Supported File Formats
formats.subtitle: Comprehensive coverage for all your media and documents.

how_it_works.title: How Metadata Cleaning Works

steps.d: Select files using drag-and-drop. They never leave your device.
Our WASM engine scans the binary structure for known tags.
Tags are stripped or randomized based on your logic matrix settings.
Save the clean file back to your system instantly.

how_it_works.localNote: Files are processed locally inside your browser and are never uploaded to servers.

warning.title: Metadata Limitations
items: Some platforms may add new metadata after upload.
Always verify cleaned files locally if anonymity is critical.
Metadata removal improves privacy but does not guarantee absolute anonymity.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about protecting your digital identity by stripping metadata.

items.q: What kind of metadata can be removed from my files?
items.a: Our Metadata Scrubber can strip EXIF data (camera model, settings), GPS location coordinates, author information, and hidden document properties from images and PDFs.

items.q: Why should I remove metadata before sharing photos?
items.a: Photos often contain hidden GPS coordinates and time stamps that can reveal your exact location. Removing this metadata is a crucial step for protecting your privacy online.
